body.message:
Please note that Upside Living has its own management team that handles cleaning services. Once you check in, if you require cleaning, you can simply contact the reception team, and they will assist you.

Cleaning is not included in our rate, and Upside Living does not allow external cleaning companies to provide services in the building.

As an approximate guide, the cleaning fee is around AED 165 per service, although the actual rate may be lower and will be confirmed by the building management.

*Also, please note that children are not allowed in this property.*
